# ICUHUB

> Standalone integration hub: vendor connectors, credential broker, action policy and approvals, audit, and OCSF/SARIF normalization, exposed to internal platforms through REST, MCP, an event stream, and webhook ingress. No AI code. Phase 1: shared schema package (`packages/icuhub-schemas`); service not built yet.

## Instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical rules for AI coding agents and humans

## Design
- [Business requirements](docs/BRD.md): goals, scope, requirements (BR/FR/NFR), integration catalog, risks, decisions D1-D17
- [High-level design](docs/HLD.md): components, data model, connector framework, pipelines, REST/MCP/events/webhooks, security, deployment, consumer contract, roadmap
- [Communication matrix](docs/COMMATRIX.md): every network flow with ports, auth, and examples
- [Prior art](docs/PRIOR_ART.md): integration designs of comparable security, DevOps, and platform projects; lessons PA-01..PA-41
- [Connector framework](docs/CONNECTOR_FRAMEWORK.md): connector contract, manifest, sync engine, mapping, identity, actions, testing kit
- [Connector guide](docs/CONNECTOR_GUIDE.md): checklist for adding a vendor connector
- [Integration inventory](docs/INTEGRATION_INVENTORY.md): integrations found in existing consumers and their ICUHUB disposition
- [Technology options](docs/OPTIONS.md): options per concern, licenses, air-gap fit, decision outcomes
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): delivery phases P0-P10 with brainstorm, write, plan, implement, test steps
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/README.md)
